units: <cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 29:6">Kel. XXIX, 6</cite> <he>חוט … של צ׳</he> the wool-dealers’ (or weavers’) cord of balances; <cite ref="Bava Batra 89a:14">B. Bath. 89ᵃ</cite>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Eruvin 10:9">Erub. X, 9</cite> <he>שוק של צ׳</he> the wool-dealers’ market.

<cite ref="Mishnah Eduyot 3:4">Eduy.
